sam/turntable.model: A 1960s record player: a walnut wood plinth, a black vinyl record with a blue label on the platter, a chrome tonearm resting on the record, two silver knobs at the front

sam/porch.model: A small wooden front porch, built like a little open hut: a raised plank deck, four white posts holding up a corrugated tin roof, a white railing along the front, a porch lamp under the roof, and on the deck a red electric guitar leaning against a small black amplifier

test-dev/wall.model: A massive red sandstone cliff buttress like the Naked Edge in Eldorado Canyon, Colorado: broad and blocky at its base, rising in stacked layered slabs of red and orange rock with green lichen to a sharp knife-edge arete at the top, a blue climbing rope hanging down its face

test-dev/van.model: A white high-roof camper van with an orange stripe along its side, a black roof rack, big off-road tyres, a ladder on the back doors, ready for a weekend of climbing

test-ines/oven.model: A traditional Portuguese wood-fired bread oven: a whitewashed clay dome on a low stone base, an arched brick opening with a fire glowing inside, a short chimney, three round loaves cooling on the ledge

test-ines/tram.model: A vintage Lisbon tram, Tram 28: a short wooden tram car painted yellow below and cream above, rounded roof, a row of windows down each side, a trolley pole on the roof, the number 28 on the front

test-ines/pao.model: A Portuguese Pão de Deus sweet bun: a round, golden-brown glossy brioche bun with a crackly top of toasted shredded coconut, dusted with icing sugar

sam/crate.model: A wooden crate full of vinyl records standing on end, their colourful sleeves showing, with one record leaning against the front of the crate

test-dev/pad.model: A folded blue climbing crash pad on the ground with a coiled red climbing rope on top and a chalk bag and a rack of climbing cams beside it

test-dev/camp.model: A little campsite: two folding camp chairs facing a small old green camping stove with a kettle on it, and a lantern glowing on the ground

test-ines/table.model: A small rustic wooden table with a linen cloth, a wicker basket and a tray of round golden Pão de Deus buns topped with coconut, cooling

test-ines/bench.model: A weathered wooden bench with two sacks of flour leaning against it and a wooden bread peel propped beside it
